subject: Selection Has Begun: Complete the Mandatory Form
body:
Hi Builder,

The countdown to the Berlin Robotics & AI Hackathon has officially begun, and we are moving fast!

There’s currently 800+ inscriptions.

Now that you’ve taken the initial step, it’s time to move to the next stage. We are looking for the most driven minds in Europe, and we want to know more about what you bring to the table.

### 📝 Complete Your Profile

We have opened our official selection and skills assessment form. Filling out this form is **strictly mandatory** if you want to finalize your registration and participate in the hackathon.

👉 **Link to the Form: **[https://tally.so/r/vXGxx8](https://tally.so/r/vXGxx8)

**What happens next?** 

Because spots are limited and we are committed to building high-performing, balanced teams, we will be running a selection process based on the skills and insights you provide in this form.

Please make sure to fill it out accurately and as soon as possible to ensure your application is reviewed. 

**No form, no entry!**

Following our official LinkedIn page will count favorably towards your application.

### 🚀 Stay Updated

Don't want to wait for the next email? We are posting live updates, ecosystem news, and behind-the-scenes content directly on our Linkedin page.

👉 [**Follow hacklab on LinkedIn**](https://www.linkedin.com/company/hack-lab-robotics/?viewAsMember=true) 👈

**The Hacklab Team**
